Beth is an NPC located in the  Desert Settlement. She has a quest involving Jake, where she and the player explore the  Underground Lab and uncover Jake's secrets. The first visit there unlocks  Jake's Plushie, and the second visit, which requires unlocking the Greenhouse first, grants access to the Crop Analyzer.

  • 2 Trivia

Dialogue

[edit | edit source]
Condition Dialogue
 Desert Settlement None
[NPC] Beth: That Jake fellow is a bit suspicious.
[NPC] Beth: He says he can't leave his house but I've seen him walking around all the time...
During the quest, before receiving the coordinates
[NPC] Beth: I keep thinking about Jake's behavior...
[NPC] Beth: I know I'll catch him doing something!
During the quest's coordinate step, before breaking the block
[NPC] Beth: Did you figure out the meaning of the note yet?
[NPC] Beth: Maybe you should go to the cave where I followed him. I remember there were a lot of mushrooms.
After first discovering the lab
[NPC] Beth: Seems that I have misjudged Jake, he might not have been as suspicious as I thought.
[NPC] Beth: The plushie he gave me is quite cute actually!
After completing the quest
[NPC] Beth: Thanks again for helping me discovering the truth about Jake.
[NPC] Beth: Can't believe he had a second secret lab to hide!
 The Garden First Visit
[NPC] Beth: I think I am really onto something here.
[NPC] Beth: Jake says he can't walk, but I've seen him walk yesterday.
[NPC] Beth: He also asks strangers to get him some animals, but these animals are nowhere to be found!
Accepting First Visit
[NPC] Beth: I'm getting really close to solving this mystery.
Second Visit
[NPC] Beth: I followed him today to where he brings all the animals he catches. He goes down some weird cave...
Accepting Second Visit
[NPC] Beth: Unfortunately, I couldn't follow him any further as he almost noticed me, so I backed off for now.
Third Visit
[NPC] Beth: I managed to follow him into the cave today, he had a shovel with him and a note fell out of his pocket...
Accepting Third Visit
[NPC] Beth: The note reads: "175 42 -470"
[NPC] Beth: Not really sure what these numbers mean yet, do you have any ideas?
Beth will not visit the garden again until the player digs down at the coordinates.
Fourth Visit
[NPC] Beth: You found what? A secret lab hidden inside the cave???
Accepting Fourth Visit
[NPC] Beth: We need to check this out together. I'll meet you there!
Beth will not visit the garden again until the player goes back to the lab.
Fifth Visit
[NPC] Beth: Hey, <player>, I've been thinking a lot about that lab we found... I think there's more to it than just the plushies.
Accepting Fifth Visit
[NPC] Beth: Especially with all those strange machines and experiments. I need your help again... let's meet back in the lab.
Denying
[NPC] Beth: Maybe I was wrong to trust you...
If a Co-op member has the quest
[NPC] Beth: Hi! I have a quest for a member of your co-op! Tell them to come see me!
 Underground Lab First Visit
[NPC] Beth: This is so strange...
[NPC] Beth: I can't believe this has been down here for all this time... I am speechless.
 
[NPC] Beth: WHAT? There are animals inside of here?!?! Jake is doing horrible experiments with these animals that he catches...
[NPC] Beth: He has gone completely mad! He's a psychopath!
[NPC] Beth: And look at all of these tools he has laying around here... a SAW?... a HAMMER?
[NPC] Beth: What is this psycho doing with these animals???
[NPC] Beth: Jake has a lot of explaining to do!
 
[NPC] Jake: ... BETH?? AND &&<capitalized player name>, WHAT ARE YOU GUYS DOING IN HERE???
[NPC] Jake: IT'S NOT WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE!
 
[NPC] Beth: WE KNOW WHAT YOU ARE DOING IN HERE, YOU PSYCHO! YOU WILL PAY FOR WHAT YOU ARE DOING TO THESE ANIMALS!
 
[NPC] Jake: ANIMALS? I CAN EXPLAIN, I SWEAR!
 
[NPC] Beth: WELL GO ON THEN, EXPLAIN YOURSELF!
 
[NPC] Jake: I don't know what you guys think I am doing here, but this is just my workshop!
[NPC] Jake: I am just making toys for animals...
 
[NPC] Beth: Oh really? Do you really think we are that naive?
[NPC] Beth: We know that you are experimenting with animals down here, how do you explain this tank?
 
[NPC] Jake: Those are my plushies! I preserve them in Jelly so they stay fresh!
[NPC] Jake: They look super realistic, but no animal was harmed when making them!
[NPC] Jake: I can prove it! Here, take this. This is one of the plushies I made, you can have it!
 
[NPC] Jake: So really, I am not harming them at all!
 
[NPC] Beth: Everything makes sense now...I'm sorry I yelled at you Jake. I'm so sorry.
 
[NPC] Jake: It's alright now. I was wrong to lie about it and I should have told you sooner.
 
[NPC] Beth: <player>, thank you so much for telling me what you saw here. I'll be forever grateful.
[NPC] Beth: I have to go now, I hope to see you guys soon.
 
[NPC] Jake: That was a close one, thank you <player> for having my back. Anyway, I need to go back to my business.
Start of the second visit
[NPC] Beth: This place still gives me chills... but I'm sure there's more to uncover.
[NPC] Beth: We know Jake's been hiding things, and I think we're getting closer to the truth.
[NPC] Beth: Hmm, this corner... I don't think I've noticed this before.
[NPC] Beth: There's something strange about this wall. It looks out of place...
[NPC] Beth: Wait, there's a lever here!
[NPC] Beth: What is this? A hidden passage? I knew Jake was hiding something from me, but this... this is something different.
[NPC] Beth: I don't know if we should trust this, but we've come this far... Let's see what's behind it.
Before pressing the lever
[NPC] Beth: See if you can pull down this lever, it's a bit stuck.
After pressing the lever
[NPC] Beth: I... I had no idea this was here. What could Jake be hiding in this secret part of the lab?
[NPC] Beth: It's very dark in here, where's the light-switch in this place?
[NPC] Beth: Oh... my... what is all of this?
[NPC] Beth: This is... this isn't just about plushies anymore. Jake's been working on something much bigger.
[NPC] Beth: Hybridization? Mutation? What is this madness? He's experimenting on something...
[NPC] Beth: Resilient livestock... enhanced growth rates... Jake, what have you done?
[NPC] Beth: These aren't normal crops. These are mutated... just like the ones we've been finding in the Garden. But why hide all of this down here?
A door opens from within the lab, and Jake shows up
[NPC] Jake: Beth... I told you to stay out of this.
 
[NPC] Beth: Jake! You have a lot of explaining to do, once again... What is all of this? What are you doing down here?
[NPC] Beth: Please tell me the truth this time Jake, I can't take all these lies anymore!
 
[NPC] Jake: It's... it's not what it looks like. This lab... it's for research. To improve farming techniques, to help both crops and animals adapt to new environments.
 
[NPC] Beth: Research? This doesn't look like research, Jake! This looks like you are playing with life itself. Those tanks, those animals, what are you actually doing to them?
 
[NPC] Jake: You don't understand, Beth! Farming as we know is evolving. If we don't adapt, we'll be left behind. The world's demands are growing, and so are the challenges.
 
[NPC] Beth: That doesn't give you the right to hide this from everyone. What about the risks? The ethics?
[NPC] Beth: You're creating something entirely unnatural.
 
[NPC] Jake: sigh I know it seems... wrong. But these experiments could change everything.
[NPC] Jake: Imagine crops that can survive the harshest conditions, or animals that never get sick.
[NPC] Jake: It's not just about survival, it's about thriving.
 
[NPC] Beth: And what about the things you are not telling me? What else are you hiding down here, Jake?
 
[NPC] Jake: There are some things you're better off not knowing. Not yet at least.
 
[NPC] Beth: No, Jake. I've come this far, and I won't stop now. If you won't tell me the truth, I'll find it myself.
 
[NPC] Jake: Beth, you don't understand, some things aren't ready to be uncovered. It's not about keeping secrets, it's about protecting what I've been working towards.
 
[NPC] Beth: Protecting what? Your pride? Your experiments? This isn't just about you, Jake. We have a responsibility to use this lab for good, not to bury it under layers of secrecy.
[NPC] Beth: What's this?
 
[NPC] Jake: That... is the Crop Analyzer.
 
[NPC] Beth: The Crop Analyzer? What does it do?
 
[NPC] Jake: It's a tool I've been developing. It analyzes mutations in crops, helps identify traits that can improve yield, resistance or even flavor.
[NPC] Jake: But it's not finished. It's delicate work, Beth. Work that requires precision, and data.
 
[NPC] Beth: Work that shouldn't be done in isolation. Jake, this could change everything for farmers everywhere. Why are you hiding something so revolutionary?
 
[NPC] Jake: Because it's not perfect yet. A mistake could have disastrous consequences. I didn't want to involve anyone until I was sure it was ready.
 
[NPC] Beth: Jake, you've done incredible work here. But you don't have to do it alone anymore. Let me and <player> help you.
[NPC] Beth: Together, we can finish this and make sure it's used responsibly.
 
[NPC] Jake: Alright. You're right, Beth. I've been trying to carry this burden alone for too long. If we're going to make this work, we'll do it together.
[NPC] Jake: And you, <player>, you've been instrumental in getting us to this point. You should have access to the Crop Analyzer. You've earned my trust.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • Beth is one of the NPCs the player must talk to during the quest Talk to the Villager Inhabitants.
  • After having Beth visit the player's Garden 3 times, the player can dig a block at  175, 42, -470 in the  Glowing Mushroom Cave and find a hidden base. On her 4th visit, the player can go back to the base and claim  Jake's Plushie.
